description: Department of Census and Statistics - The Colombo Consumer's Price Index for the Month of December 2014 was 180.2
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the Colombo Consumers' Price Index for December 2014, published by the Department of Census and Statistics. The content involves statistical data reporting (economic indicators) rather than government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or any of the specialized administrative categories (Types 4-9). As it doesn't fit any of the specific categories 1-9, it falls under Miscellaneous (Type 10) for general administrative announcements.
